verdicts.reason: A is basically a uniformly shrunk copy: reading order and grouping are intact, but the event-details lines and URL are tiny, around 5px and barely legible, and a large dead band of empty space sits below the URL. B scales the headline and logo up well, but it breaks reading order. The URL now sits above the 'to check if your game is in the list follow the link:' copy, which is left stranded at the bottom pointing at nothing. The URL is also oversized and competes with the tagline, the detail text is still tiny, and there is an awkward empty gap between the two groups.
